Asia/Tokyo and Asia/Shanghai are in the same time zone (UTC+9) today, but in 1553, time zones did not exist as we know them.  
Both locations would have used local solar time, so 7 PM in Tokyo would be roughly 7 PM in Shanghai, possibly with a few minutes difference due to longitude.  
Given no historical offset data, the simplest assumption is same local time.  

FINAL_ANSWER: January 12, 1553 19:00
